observations: Photo 0: a long black velvet sofa with vertical channel tufting on the back, arms and seat front, on slim gold metal legs, about three seats wide.
Photo 1: the same long sofa from the front under a framed wall print; it reads as a 3 seater.
Photo 2: a shorter black velvet sofa of the same channel tufted style and gold legs, about two seats wide, in a different spot by a dark door; it reads as a 2 seater.
Fabric looks clean and the shape is full in all three photos; no visible tears or stains, but lighting is soft and the black fabric hides marks.
No brand label or tag visible in any photo.
Backs, undersides and close ups of the fabric are not shown.
All photos carry a 'Posted on Jiji' watermark with the seller's name.

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show a three seat sofa and photo 2 a two seat sofa of matching style.
Seller states it; photos show a lived in room, consistent with used.
No close ups of the fabric, seams or seat; black velvet hides wear and stains. Contradicts the seller's own word 'used'; priced as used.
Frame and internals cannot be seen; no underside shots.
Not a working item; no clip of anyone sitting on them.

risks.risk: Sagging seats or weak frame and loose gold legs
risks.proof: A clip of an adult sitting and shifting on every seat of both sofas, and a shot of the legs and underside
risks.if_unproven: as used sofas with worn seats

risks.risk: Worn, crushed or stained velvet not visible on black fabric or on the backs
risks.proof: Close up photos of the seat, arms and back of each sofa in daylight

risks.risk: Only one of the two pieces being sold or the pieces not matching
risks.proof: One photo with both sofas side by side
risks.if_unproven: priced only as the pieces shown, as a set

risks.risk: Pests or odour in the upholstery
risks.proof: Close shots of the seams and underside lining

proof_requests: One photo of both sofas side by side in the same room
A clip of an adult sitting on each seat of both sofas
Close ups of the velvet on seats, arms and backs in daylight
Photos of the undersides and legs
A tape measure across each sofa's width
response.reason: The photos clearly show a black velvet channel tufted 3 seater and 2 seater sofa set, identified by type. It can be priced as a used set at its worst case, with the like new and receipt claims left as unproven conditions.
